description: This Java test class `LoanCOBFilterHelperTest` tests the behavior of the `LoanCOBFilterHelper` class, specifically handling JSON request filtering and loan ID extraction within the context of the Apache Fineract project. It uses JUnit 5 and Mockito for unit testing.
